question: 2026年9月一共有多少笔支付记录？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_payment WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
note: 按支付时间过滤

question: 现在有多少个商品已经下架了？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_product WHERE status = 'off_shelf'

question: 铂金会员有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_customer WHERE member_level = '铂金'

question: 2026年9月订单的平均优惠金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 优惠属营销让利，不过滤订单状态

question: 库存快照里所有商品的日平均库存量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(stock_qty), 2) AS avg_stock FROM fact_inventory_snapshot

question: 2026年9月有多少个不同的客户下过单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 下单行为，不过滤状态

question: 2026年9月下单量（含取消订单）最多的五个省份是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT r.province AS province, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY r.province ORDER BY cnt DESC, r.province ASC LIMIT 5
note: 省份是 province，不是大区

question: 2026年9月各会员等级分别贡献了多少GMV？
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level AS member_level, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 2026年9月销售额最高的五个品牌是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS sales FROM fact_order_item i JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales DESC, p.brand ASC LIMIT 5
note: 明细口径 item_amount

question: 2026年9月哪个营销活动的下单量最多（含取消订单）？
gold_sql: SELECT cm.campaign_name AS campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_campaign cm ON cm.campaign_id = o.campaign_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY cm.campaign_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, cm.campaign_name ASC LIMIT 1
note: 活动字段 70% 为空，需注意 NULL

question: 2026年9月天猫渠道的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS arpu FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE ch.channel_name = '天猫' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 客单价分母是去重客户数

question: 2026年9月销量最高的三个一级品类是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT top.category_name AS cate, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty FROM fact_order_item i JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN dim_category sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN dim_category top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY top.category_name ORDER BY qty DESC, top.category_name ASC LIMIT 3
note: 销量用 quantity 求和，不是金额

question: 2026年8月的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01'

question: 2026年9月GMV同比2025年9月增长了多少百分比？
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND ((order_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-10-01') OR (order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01')) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN gmv END) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2025-09' THEN gmv END) - 100.0, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM m
note: 同比 = (今年-去年)/去年

question: 2026年9月1日到9月7日的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-08'
note: 闭区间转半开区间

question: 2026年9月有多少天产生了订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_date) AS days FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

question: 2026年9月下单量最多的是星期几？返回数字（1=周一，7=周日）
gold_sql: SELECT d.week_day AS week_day FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY d.week_day ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, d.week_day ASC LIMIT 1

question: 2026年10月一共有多少个订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
note: 数据只到 2026-09-30，结果应为 0

question: 2026年9月的退款率是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM fact_refund r JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND r.completed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), 0), 2) AS refund_rate
note: 金额口径：已完成退款 / GMV

question: 2026年9月的取消率是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 分母是全部下单数

question: 按支付日期统计，2026年9月的回款是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.paid_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_payment p JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
note: 回款按 paid_at，不是 order_date

question: 2026年9月有复购的客户有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t
note: 复购 = 有效订单>=2 的客户数

question: 2026年9月每位客户平均下了多少单？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS orders_per_customer FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 下单行为口径，分母为去重客户数

question: 2026年9月线下门店渠道的订单占比是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ch.channel_name = '线下门店' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 占比属结构指标，不过滤状态

question: 2026年9月通过活动带来的GMV占全月GMV的多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.campaign_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(o.total_amount), 0), 2) AS pct FROM fact_order o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 活动字段 70% 为空，占比口径
